messages:
Maya: Quick async standup re: NexaPay renewal escalation — embeddings/webhook errors.
Maya: What I did: triaged customer reports, verified ~12% embedding calls returning 504s since 03:00 UTC, correlated with larger payloads and bursts. Opened ticket CS-4982 and attached sample payloads + logs.
Maya: Blockers: need eng to check proxy limits (max_batch_bytes / request size) and confirm whether model fallback to smaller embed model is enabled for NexaPay. Also want a quick canary we can run so I can tell the CSM what to expect.
Arjun: On it. Can you paste one example request_id and payload size?
Maya: request_id: a1d2f3e4, payload_size: 256kb. Error snippet: 
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
{"error":"upstream read timeout","upstream_addr":"10.4.5.6:8080"}
```
Maya: Dashboard (internal): https://console.redwood.internal/d/embeddings?panelId=7&from=now-1h — spike on shard 12.
Leo: I can see elevated proxy latency for shard 12. Autoscaler looks like it didn't scale due to CPU requests bumping node limits. Will investigate node pressure and any recent infra changes.
Arjun: My plan: roll a canary patch reducing `max_batch_bytes` to 200k for the embeddings proxy and flip on fallback to `embed-small-v1`. That should reduce request amplification. Need @Sam to approve potential short-term quality regression for the canary.
Sam: approve a limited canary. Prioritize — if success criteria (504s down >50% in 15m) then promote. Keep CS posted.
Maya: I'll update NexaPay CSM and mention canary. If not stabilized by EOD I'll flag renewal risk.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: `embed-proxy-config-canary` by @Arjun — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9876
Leo: Quick command if you need logs: `kubectl logs -n inference pod/embed-proxy-xyz -c proxy --tail=200 | grep a1d2f3e4`
Arjun: Starting canary now. Will post metrics in ~15m.
Maya: Sending NexaPay message: "We're investigating increased embed errors; running a temporary config canary and will update in 30m." :pray:
Marta: FYI I've paused renewal outreach until we see stability, otherwise we push follow-up to next week.
Arjun: Canary results after 12m: 504s down ~62% for shard 12, median latency down 18ms. I'll extend to 30m and then promote if stable.
Maya: Awesome — I'll tell NexaPay and mark CS ticket with results.
Sam: thanks team. If anything regresses revert the canary asap and ping infra on-call.
Maya: No other blockers from CS side. Will close this thread after final promote + note to NexaPay.
